5.o: Ji-Yoon visits Pembroke's new lecturer as Bill joins in on a Korean tradition. The tenured professors band together, and Yaz receives an enticing offer.

6.o: As his hearing approaches, Bill's academic future comes into question. Ji-Yoon's revelation puts the board on the spot and shakes up the department.

1.o: Feride changed her name to Gizem after running away from her brother-in-law, Cemil out of fear for her life. The young woman who has built a new life for herself has a happy marriage. Gizem learns that her whole family has been killed in a TV show and that Cemil is still after her and her older sister Nesime who has fled with her lover. Nesime and Feride's paths cross again after many years - While Gizem struggles so that her and her sister's true identities are not revealed, her husband Mehmet has secrets from his past that he hides from his wife.

Following the death of Henry VIII, his three children; Mary, Elizabeth and Edward are now pawns in a dangerous game as the English court is plunged into a race for control of the new England they find themselves in.

2.t: You Cannot Keep the Birds From Flying Over Your Head
2.o: Christmas at court, and a controversial masque leaves Protestant Edward and Catholic Mary at odds. Elizabeth finds herself in the middle as Mary demands she come live with her.

3.o: The Lord Protector’s plan for peace between the siblings only causes Catherine and Thomas to accelerate their own, using Elizabeth’s 15th birthday as cover.

4.o: Having been sent away from Catherine and Thomas' household, Elizabeth is amongst strangers in the house of Kat's brother-in-law Antony Denny, and terrified of anyone finding out her secrets from Chelsea Place.

5.t: Necessity Compels Me to Plague You
5.o: Elizabeth is determined to not fall into the same traps she did when last she was at Chelsea. While the court has been rocked by Mary’s defiance, the Lord Somerset is still more concerned with the war in Scotland.

6.o: Both Elizabeth and Somerset face the consequences of Thomas’ actions, while Mary finds that she is the only family member that the king can now trust.

7.t: To Laugh, To Lie, To Flatter, To Face
7.o: There is a new Lord Protector and Mary and Elizabeth both find themselves at the mercy of the new regime and their zealous little brother.

8.o: With the king sick, court fears he will be succeeded by one of his sisters, but which sister?

1.o: Bandit Joaquin Murrieta, accompanied by Adela Cheng, seeks redemption while rancher Joaquin Carrillo and his family face hostilities from the Rangers in the new California.

2.o: Carrillo seeks revenge with Damace’s help. South of the border, Harry Love closes in on Murrieta and Adela.

3.o: Murrieta and Carrillo’s paths cross and they join forces to complete an important mission.

4.o: The Joaquines face off with the Rangers in an ambush. Both Murrieta and Carrillo come face to face with their enemies.

5.o: Murrieta must dig into his past to save Adela before the Rangers find out where they are hiding.

6.o: In exchange for the gold in Carrillo’s old mine, The Joaquines agree to help the rancher in his quest for vengeance. To get to the mine, they will have to cross dangerous Chiwa lands and avoid capture by Love.

7.o: With the help of a Mormon family, Murrieta survives. Carrillo and Adela craft a plan to rob the mine.

8.o: Two final duels will forever mark Murrieta and Carrillo’s destinies.

1.o: A young CIA targeter, Lena Asayran, connects a 2007 attack on US forces in Iraq to the CIA’s greatest adversary, Imad Mughniyeh. Lena manipulates a defector from Iran into revealing the murky origins of Imad’s rise at 19 years old. In 1983, CIA officer Robert Ames believes he can force Israel to withdraw and implement a regional peace plan. But young Imad senses an opportunity and plans the first suicide bombing in the Middle East. Ames’ optimistic vision clashes with Imad’s determination to remake the Middle East.

2.o: Following an attack on the US Embassy, the CIA appoints soldier-of-fortune William Buckley as the new Station Chief, along with case officer Chet Riley to track down the unknown attacker. Chet recruits a source close to Imad and uncovers the only image the CIA would have for the next 25 years. Imad escalates his attacks, bombing the US Marines barracks and kidnapping Buckley rattling the White House and CIA Director William Casey. The US withdraws from Lebanon and Imad Mughniyeh emerges as one of the most powerful players in the Middle East.

3.o: Two decades after his emergence, Imad Mughniyeh is weary of his life in the shadows. Imad has his men kidnap US soldiers in Iraq, but their failed escape draws the attention of Lena Asayran. The head of Mossad, Meir Dagan orders his best officer, Teddy, to contact Lena to persuade the CIA to help kill Mughniyeh. Imad falls for a businesswoman in Damascus, and the family drama that unfolds creates an unprecedented opportunity for Lena and Teddy to identify Imad for the first time in 25 years.

4.o: Armed with the evidence she and Teddy have gathered, Lena asks the White House to authorize the killing of Imad; but the operation is only possible if the CIA works hand-in-hand with Mossad. Imad persuades Iran to provide him access to chemical weapons. The enormous stakes and time pressure lead to a near-rupture between Mossad and the CIA, until Lena extracts more information from the Iranian defector, Imad’s original recruiter back in Beirut, which enables the joint CIA-Mossad operation to enter its decisive, final chapter.

1.t: Why Don't You Go for a Ride?
1.o: Freshly graduated from middle school, loner Yanagi Yukito finds himself spirited away to his childhood home on the Ayaka Islands. There, he discovers that he is descended from a line of magic users known as Ley Masters.

2.o: Jingi takes Yukito on his first job to pacify an Ara-Mitama chasing people away from the local canal, but the origin of the problem may be closer to home than either of them believed.

3.t: Those Two Have a Lot of Issues
3.o: Yukito and Jingi visit the First Island, a popular tourist destination. There, they meet Ibuki, another former disciple of Yukito's father, but one who has a very different view on how to handle Ara-Mitama.

4.o: While visiting Kasen Shrine, Yukito is surprised by an offer of friendship from Kurama's disciples Yako and Chataro. But when they put his Ley Mastery to the test, he finds his fear of losing control of his powers again may not be unfounded.

5.o: Yukito learns a bit more about his father's legacy and the lasting impression he's left behind on the people of the Ayaka Islands. During a visit to his grave, he runs into Ibara, Aka's stonefaced associate.

6.t: My Master Would've Given Us an Earful
6.o: Yukito tries to fend off the Ara-Mitama with Ibara, Chataro, and Yuko. When Aka and Haruaki arrive to help, things get heated as their ideals clash and emotions run high.

7.o: A glimpse into the halcyon past when Aka, Haruaki, and Jingi were Makoto's young disciples, and how Makoto stepped up to save the Ayaka Islands one fateful night when disaster struck.

8.t: You've Come to Wear Some Better Expressions
8.o: Yukito attends a summer festival with all his new friends as he tries to enjoy some semblance of a normal life for a boy his age, but the evening's peace rests on shaky ground.

9.o: The Ayaka Islands prepare for an evacuation after the eruption on the Fourth Island. As everyone makes their own preparations to try and help save the islands, Yukito discovers the truth about his identity.

10.o: As the fire dragon rampages and threatens the future of the Ayaka Islands, Jingi steels his resolve and prepares to follow through on a promise he made years ago.

11.o: The Ayaka Islands are safe again thanks to Jingi, but his choice causes ripples of emotions through the island's inhabitants and strife among the Ley Masters. In his despair, Yukito sees a light in the darkness, and makes a decision of his own.

12.o: Yukito takes a leap of faith and dives into the Ley Energy, and encounters a certain soul while searching for Jingi. On the outside, the other Ley Masters band together to help lead him home.

1.o: Jasem, a poor family man, decides to teach his son Farhan a useful trade to curb his mischief, while Abu Issa, a wealthy merchant, continues to exploit the poor.

2.o: Farhan stands up to Abu Issa as he attempts to strike a friend. Jasem struggles to sell the winter coats he made. Later, Abu Issa sneaks out of his house at night.

3.o: Jasem starts his new job on a joyous note. A merchant named Bidah arrives at Al-Ahsa with an unexpected request from the traders.

4.o: Abu Mousa works tirelessly to fulfill Bidah's request. Jasem visits his family in Al-Ahsa, but leaves behind something that troubles his wife, Badriya.

5.o: Abu Issa offers Abu Mousa a solution to his dilemma. Ruwaished's wife turns to an unusual method to conceive. Meanwhile, Jasem’s friendship with Julia grows stronger.

6.o: Farhan hatches a plan to get back at Abu Issa. Badriya, enticed by an attractive offer, heads to the latter’s residence, as she receives a troubling letter from Jasem.

7.o: Abu Swailem heads to the police station after his crops are vandalised. Badriya's friendship with Shaikha strengthens, while Sultan tries to stir up trouble.

8.o: Khalifa's disappearance stirs concern. Al Smaideh finds himself in trouble, while Sultan instills doubt in Jasem’s mind over Badriya.

9.o: Jasem goes above and beyond to win Badriya back. Farhan decides to exact revenge on Abu Issa, who becomes the biggest beneficiary of the ongoing turmoil.

10.o: Shaikha is dissatisfied as household changes begin to take shape in her own home. Meanwhile, stories about a jinn dwelling in the mountain leave Abu Issa spooked.

11.o: Umm Ahmed is hesitant to accept Matouq's marriage proposal. The change in Badriya's behaviour upsets Abu Issa, as Shaikha tries to exploit the situation.

12.o: A burdened Abu Mousa reveals a secret to Abu Taher. Sultan returns to the village looking for Jasem.

13.o: The unexpected return of a certain someone takes Matouq by surprise, as a conflict erupts between Abu Issa’s three wives.

14.o: Sara’s delivery due date nears. Ahmed draws Abu Mousa’s attention to the bisht Bidah’s wearing. Meanwhile, Badriya wins Abu Issa’s favour once again.

15.o: Abu Issa looks through his old ledgers for any debt that needs collecting. Jasem returns from his solitude in the mountains in search of his son Farhan.

16.o: Ahmed and Farhan find a clue that could lead them to the bisht thief. Elsewhere, Jasem vows to seek vengeance against Abu Issa.

17.o: Tension between Badriya and Shaikha escalates. Abu Issa tries to run the factory, while Farhan lends a helping hand to Abu Othman.

18.o: Abu Ahmed asks Ruwaished if Abu Issa was the reason his son committed suicide. Meanwhile, Jasem strives to preserve traditional tailoring.

19.o: Mariam tries to sneak into Badriya's room. Ahmed brings an unexpected guest to Farhan and Al Smaideh’s camp. Later, Abu Othman surprises Farhan with a proposal.

20.o: Badriya discovers that her necklace is missing. Farhan makes up his mind about Abu Othman's offer. A heated confrontation breaks out between Jasem and Abu Issa.

1.o: Caleb Mir, a brilliant street kid, is offered admission to the new Starfleet Academy class.

2.o: Caleb questions whether he belongs at Starfleet Academy as the new academic year begins.

3.o: While our cadets compete to join an elite team at the Academy, a battle of escalating pranks breaks out between Starfleet Academy and a rival school. Tensions rise fast, threatening their newly-emerging bonds and a blossoming romance.

4.o: When an existential crisis threatens to wipe out a beloved but infamous Star Trek species, a cadet is forced to confront his past and strained relationship with his family. As he pursues an unexpected method of coping, Nahla races against time to save this species from extinction.

5.o: As a cadet sets out to solve an ancient Starfleet mystery, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery and learns the value of forging her own path. Meanwhile, Nahla agrees to help a fellow chancellor with an elaborate alien ritual.

6.o: During the cadets' first training mission on an abandoned ship, they encounter a dangerous new enemy and must fight for survival while Nahla seeks help from an unexpected source.

7.o: During a school holiday, cadets return home and must choose between family expectations and dreams.

8.o: A visiting instructor arrives at the Academy and uses an unorthodox method to help the cadets process the emotions of what it takes to become a Starfleet officer.

9.o: As the year ends, Caleb must choose between the life he wanted and the life he's built at Starfleet Academy. Meanwhile, Nahla breaks protocol to keep her promise.

10.o: The return of an old enemy forces Nahla to confront her own mistakes as the cadets and instructors undertake a seemingly impossible mission to save the Federation, while defining the future of Starfleet.

1.o: Orphaned Xiao Bangchui follows her half-baked master, posing as disciples of an immortal sect. While on their way to "exorcise demons" for a wealthy family, they accidentally expose Lei Xiuyuan, a young man on the run from pursuers. That very night, Xiao Bangchui's master vanishes without a word, leaving behind only a letter instructing her to seek out her senior brother at Chufeng Academy.

2.o: Hearing that the owner of Yange Tavern is renowned for obtaining past academy exam topics, Xiao Bangchui rushes over to inquire about them, only to learn that the price is exorbitant. Just as she's worrying over the cost, Lei Xiuyuan shows up again. After Master Yan praises him as a man of exceptional beauty, Xiao Bangchui promptly sells Lei Xiuyuan off for a hefty price.

3.o: Lei Xiuyuan appears to be helping Xiao Bangchui, but he has motives of his own. Unaware of his true intentions, the two repeatedly stumble into misunderstandings, only to earn a reputation among the academy examiners for their compassion and kindness.

4.o: As the disciples are assigned their rooms, Lifei discovers the mask Lei Xiuyuan wore when he attacked her. Left with no choice, Lei Xiuyuan finally reveals the tragic story behind the relentless pursuit that has haunted him.

5.o: Jiang Lifei takes Lei Xiuyuan to seek treatment for his injuries. As Elder Zhu recounts the Seafall Catastrophe 500 years ago, strange and unfamiliar visions begin to flash through Lei Xiuyuan's mind.

6.o: Ji Tongzhou, who is also in the Futu Tower, suddenly appears and urges the two to leave at once. The Spirit-Releasing Manual slips from Lifei's arms and falls to the ground, unleashing several fiery serpent-shaped word spirits that charge toward her. At the critical moment, Hu Jiaping emerges from the shadows and comes to their aid, allowing the three of them to make a hasty escape.

7.o: The black aura surrounding Lei Xiuyuan is cleansed away, and he regains consciousness. To his astonishment, he finds Lifei enveloped in a faint white glow, as though she is shedding her old self and emerging anew. At the same time, a strange fragrance begins to emanate from her.

8.o: Ri Yan finally reveals himself. Already wounded, Zong Quan is no match for him and is forced to flee in defeat. Lei Xiuyuan's meridians are shattered, and his spiritual root is completely destroyed. Ri Yan tells Lifei that something in Ganhua Realm of Qingqiu can save Lei Xiuyuan.

9.o: As the Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, everyone gathers to make mooncakes. Lei Xiuyuan begins to miss Lu Shanhua. Lifei comforts him and promises that once he has recovered, they will go to Xingzheng Hall together to take on Zhen Yun.

10.o: Driven to despair, Lei Xiuyuan resolves to die. Discovering that he is still alive, Lifei returns to the academy. Although Lei Xiuyuan sincerely apologizes for deceiving her, Lifei cannot bring herself to forgive him.

11.o: Before setting off for the Eastern Sea with Jiao, Mo Yanfan decides to remove the bond created by the Eternal Fragrance Token binding the three of them. But the moment he begins the ritual, the token suddenly flares up, nearly causing a backlash. He warns them that the bond cannot be broken-not while they still have feelings for one another.

12.o: Lifei, Ji Tongzhou, Ge Ling, and Chang Yue bid each other a reluctant farewell. With parting imminent, they promise to reunite three years later.

13.o: While searching the scrolls in Huanyue Shrine, Lifei discovers that Shefeng Peak is the 17th peak of Wuyue Court. She tricks Chong Yi into revealing its whereabouts. Just as Lifei is about to break through the barrier surrounding Shefeng Peak, the hexagonal prism beneath her feet spirals out of control and sends her plunging. Looking at the Eternal Fragrance Token in his hand, Lei Xiuyuan realizes Lifei is in danger.

14.o: A disciple of the immortal sect has been secretly cultivating demonic arts. Guang Wei orders Qin Yangling to gather the disciples immediately, set up a demon-subduing formation, and thoroughly investigate both the inner and outer disciples.

15.o: At the Yuelian Pool, Lei Xiuyuan regains consciousness only to be wounded again. Qin Yangling appears and pretends to treat his wounds, intending to launch a surprise attack. Lei Xiuyuan stays alert and evades him. He then asks Qin Yangling to deliver the Lingzhu Fruit to Baicao Peak. Lifei finally wakes up.

16.o: After her Top Eight opponent is exposed for secretly cultivating demonic arts, Lifei advances to the semifinals by default. She is set to face Yue Cailing, while Lei Xiuyuan will take on Qin Yangling.

17.o: The Linglong Talisman signals that fellow disciples are in danger. As the group takes to the air on their flying swords, black demonic energy suddenly erupts from a crack in the rocks. Lifei flies through the dark mist, only to discover that Lei Xiuyuan and the others have disappeared.

18.o: Lifei is ambushed by a demonic spirit, leaving her seemingly drained of all spiritual energy. Lei Xiuyuan protects her and transfers his own spiritual energy to her, but collapses from exhaustion. Facing death, the two finally confess their feelings.

19.o: Ji Tongzhou invites Lifei out for a meal. On the way, they come across the Guangsheng Society, capturing a spirit beast. Sympathizing with the abused creature, Lifei uses her magic to rescue it.

20.o: As the group flies back on their swords, they return to find Duanming City in chaos. Taking advantage of the turmoil, the once-tamed spirit beasts rebel and break free, scattering across the city. The disciples of the various immortal sects split up to fend off the rampaging spirit beasts of all sizes.

21.o: Lifei, Lei Xiuyuan, and Ji Tongzhou cover for one another and successfully clear their names. Shi Chengtian confesses that Luo Cha manipulated him into using Bewitching Spirit Powder to drive the spirit beasts mad, giving them an excuse to kill the beasts and sell them for money.

22.o:
Miao Qing brings out a child, who turns out to be Ji Tongzhou's nephew, Crown Prince Ji Jingwu.

Holding his only remaining family tightly, Ji Tongzhou silently vows to do everything in his power to protect Yue Kingdom for generations to come.

23.o: Ji Tongzhou returns to the imperial palace. Lan Ya dreams of becoming the queen, but Ji Tongzhou would rather endure the searing pain of the Xuanhua Sacred Fire burning his heart than let the Heartbond Pill live, choosing to burn it to ashes.

24.o: Lifei and Lei Xiuyuan enter Hushe Peak, where they discover a wooden hut inside the maple forest barrier that looks exactly like the one in Qingqiu. Lifei, shaken and dazed, pushes the door open. A wave of immense resentment surges out from within.

25.o: Guang Wei, Chong Yi, and Qin Yangling find Lifei and Lei Xiuyuan. The two flee to the edge of a cliff. Knowing there are vines below, Lei Xiuyuan pretends to push Lifei off the cliff.

26.o: Major immortal sects send their elders and senior disciples to Wuyue Court to demand that Cui Xuan hand Lifei over. As the situation spirals out of control, Cui Xuan decides to put her on public trial at Wuyue Summit and discuss with the assembled sects how Jianmu's power should be dealt with.

27.o: Ji Tongzhou leads the disciples of Xingzheng Hall to Wuyue Court, where they engage the Demon Clan in a fierce battle. Amid the chaos, Luo Cha escapes with the badly wounded Lei Xiuyuan.

28.o: Ye Ye and Chang Yue decide to leave the selfish and narrow-minded Dizang Sect and travel to the Eastern Sea to support Ge Lin. Before departing, they bid farewell to Lifei and take on the important task of visiting Si Mo's family in his hometown.

29.o: At the Wanxian Sect, Ji Tongzhou warns Lifei that Seafall is approaching and she must not trust others too easily. Lu Li, in particular, is a spirit and may be under the demons' control.

30.o: To protect Lifei, Ji Tongzhou publicly announces that she is his partner. After hearing the news of Lifei's upcoming wedding, Ge Lin gives her a pair of matching love knots.

31.o: Back at the Wanxian Sect, Lifei is placed under house arrest by Ji Tongzhou to protect her from threats both within and beyond the Immortal Sect. However, Lifei remains determined to find a way to stop the approaching Seafall.

32.o: As raging flames surge from the earth, the Mountain and Sea Barrier teeters on the brink of collapse. Ji Tongzhou temporarily stabilizes it with his powerful Xuanhua Sacred Fire, but Seafall's might is far beyond anything mortals can withstand.

33.o: Lifei and her companions seize the opportunity to rescue Ge Lin and break free from the formation. Enraged after regaining Lifei only to lose her again, Ji Tongzhou leads the disciples of Xingzheng Hall in laying siege to Chufeng Academy under the pretext of eliminating the demon threat. He demands that Master Zuo Qiu surrender Lifei and Xiuyuan by the following morning, or he will burn the Academy to the ground with the Xuanhua Sacred Fire.
